title: Goodreads TBR Age by Shelf
dataSources: Highlights (`reading:highlight`), book activity (`reading:book`), reviews (`reading:review`), paper libraries (`research:paper`), sync states (`reading:sync`).
app: Reading and second-brain telemetry — Readwise review exports, Kindle highlights, Goodreads shelves, and Zotero research libraries — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reading:book platform="goodreads" shelf=* tbr_age_days=*
| stats avg(tbr_age_days) as avg_tbr_age_days, count as events by shelf
| sort - avg_tbr_age_days
description: Shows average TBR age days by shelf for Goodreads reading backlog.
value: Average TBR age days by shelf helps compare Goodreads reading backlog across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `tbr_age_days` on `reading:book` events and normalize `shelf` so Splunk can summarize performance by shelf.
visualization: Bar chart of average TBR age days by shelf.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights the average TBR age days for each shelf so you can see what works best for Goodreads reading backlog.
